description: Employee Module — Ratings (Overall / AI / Communication rating popups, Advanced Filter by Rating, Employee Ratings edit drawer). Suggested dedicated code EMPRAT (not yet assigned — see req-2026-07-13-GEN-doc.json unclear[]). Filed under moduleCode GEN pending that decision.
businessRules: Double-clicking Save in the Overall/AI/Communication rating popup must not create duplicate rating records or cause a conflicting overwrite of the value.

Saving the Employee Ratings edit drawer must reflect updated rating values in the Ratings table immediately without a page reload, mirroring the cache-refresh requirement already established for the base Employee edit drawer.
edgeCases: Advanced Filter by Rating combined criteria yielding 0 results — verify the empty-state/'0 results show' rendering (the brief only captured a nonzero '2 results show' sample).
V1 (7 filters) vs V2 (9 filters) — verify which variant is the live build before asserting a fixed filter-row count in automation.
Rating popup positioned near the table edge/last row — verify the small anchored popup (~260x190px) does not render off-screen or clipped.

Rating category popup pattern (Overall/AI/Communication) — verify Cancel discards the edit and Save persists it identically across all three categories, since a fix/break in one is likely to affect all (shared-component regression risk).
Ratings tab shows only 2 Table Rows in this export (vs. 11+ on the Employee tab) — verify this reflects a genuinely small rated-team sample rather than an unintended filter/bug hiding rows.
